statement.p: Consider the multiplication operator L_A:{\mathbb R}^2\to {\mathbb R}^2 defined by L_A(x)=Ax where A=\left[\begin{array}{cc} -1 \amp 0\cr 3 \amp -3 \end{array}\right]. Find an ordered basis B=(b_1,b_2) for {\mathbb R}^2 such that [L_A]_B^B=\left[\begin{array}{cc} -13 \amp -15\cr 8 \amp 9 \end{array}\right]. Hint: [L_A]_E^E=A where E is the standard basis.
